Built for critical applications.

Er-Con combines disciplined engineering, proprietary technologies and hands-on field execution to protect infrastructure, property and natural resources.

Our work includes exposed pipeline remediation, bank stabilization, channel restoration, bridge protection and other complex erosion-control challenges across creeks, rivers, lakes, ponds, stormwater systems and coastlines.

More than 3,000 completed projects have reinforced a practical standard: engineer for performance, plan for constructability and build for demanding field conditions.

River Stabilization

Address severe bank retreat threatening pipeline easements, rail subgrades, highway approaches and high-value waterfront property.

Pipeline Exposures & Free Spans

Correcting pipeline exposure, restoring reliable support and stabilizing the surrounding site.

Critical Infrastructure

Protecting bridges, crossings and other civil infrastructure for municipalities, commercial properties and public agencies.

Erosion Control Systems

Site-specific systems engineered and installed to manage flow, stabilize vulnerable ground and protect critical assets.

Dedicated expertise at every stage.

Our in-house teams connect technical evaluation, engineering, permitting and field execution, giving clients a single accountable partner from initial site assessment through installation.

Surveys

Field teams document the site condition, surrounding constraints and forces acting on the site. That information helps our engineers distinguish the visible symptom from the underlying problem.

Scoping

From that foundation, we define the problem, the assets at risk and the boundaries of the work. The team evaluates alternatives and establishes a clear, defensible path forward.

Drawings

Er-Con engineers translate field conditions into practical, site-specific engineering and construction documents. Each drawing accounts for constructability and long-term performance.

Permitting & Approvals

Permitting extends beyond environmental review to floodplain and other site-specific requirements. Er-Con prepares and submits applications, coordinates with agencies and sees every required permit through review and approval before work moves into the field.

Installations

In the field, Operations coordinates local vendors and suppliers while managing safety, quality and changing site conditions. When challenges arise, crews make informed field adjustments without compromising the intent of the design.

Long-Term Protection

The result is a site-specific solution that addresses the forces behind the problem, stabilizes the site and protects critical assets for years to come.

Solutions designed around the problem, not the other way around.

Er-Con engineers each solution around the forces acting on the site, the assets at risk and the realities of construction. Before a design reaches a client, our engineering and field leaders review it together, applying decades of field experience to constructability, sequencing and long-term performance. That discipline creates a clear path from field investigation and permitting through installation.

Expertise that travels. Local knowledge that matters.

Er-Con's dedicated teams bring proven systems and project leadership to every site. Wherever practical, we leverage local equipment providers and material suppliers, supporting the surrounding community while maintaining ownership of the work from start to finish.

Our crews minimize disruption to the customer, surrounding property and environment. They limit the project footprint, restore disturbed areas and leave the site better than they found it. Customers regularly recognize Er-Con for the care our teams bring to the work.
